Name: Bachelorettes Cards for Sexy Market Idols and Card Generator
Author: Tyr4nTX
Description:
[b][u][b][u]Update: You don t like AI ? You can now deactivate ALL Original Cards in GMCM and in Config.json on the MAIN MOD (Beware if you change it in GMCM you have to restart SDV) ...

I also added a paragraph so you can see wich
custom content pack is loading! and so you know! I m also not a fan of
AI ! I like self-drawn much better! But i just can t draw! Sorry !:(

IMPORTANT: Youre Custom Cards must have ONE rule! There must be a TextField on the
Button of the Card so the stats are shown! Nothing else just that! [/u][/b]


BIG UPDATE: Added 30 new Cards to this Collection! There are now common, rare and epic variants of the Bachelorettes... Have fun! All with specific Tags of course! 


Update Card Generator:[/u] Nor more Conlicts with other Card Content Packs, because you can now enter your unique ID for the cards.... Also you can now Extending Existing Packs so you don t have to it all over again! Content Pack has to be in the OUTPUT folder...
[list=1]
[*]Run the generator
[*]Select [b]"[2] Extend existing Content Pack"[/b]
[*]Choose which pack to extend
[*]Add new cards - IDs will automatically continue from your highest existing number
[/list]


Sexy Market Idols – New Idol Cards (Content Pack) + Community Card Generator[/b]

More cards. More idols. More collecting. ✨

This is a [b]plug-and-play Content Pack[/b] for [b]Sexy Market Idols[/b] that adds [b][u]15[/u][/b] freshly  AI generated Idol Cards (Bachlorettes from SDV) to your game.

✅ InstallJust extract into:

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code]
✅ Requirements

[list]
[*][b]Sexy Market Idols[/b] (main mod)
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*]Other dependencies as listed on the main mod page
[/list][line]
🛠️ Community Tool: Card GeneratorWant to create your own Idol Cards without touching JSON by hand?
I’m uploading a [b]Card Generator[/b] that turns a single image into a complete Content Pack.
[b]Steps:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Put framed card images into the [b]Input[/b] folder
[*]Run [code]Start.bat[/code]
[*]Fill out the prompts (rarity, name, tags, etc.)
[*]Done: a full Content Pack is generated → drop into [code]Mods/[/code] → play!
[/list]Have fun creating & sharing packs — I’d love to see what the community comes up with.
